5. Mr. Shiven Varma, learned counsel appears on behalf of respondents on advance copy; accepts notice; and seeks time to file reply in CM APPL. No. 61145/2025.
6.
Let reply to the application be filed within 06 weeks; rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within 04 weeks thereafter; with copy to the opposing counsel.
7. In the meantime, the appellants are directed to file an affidavit setting- out the proposed questions of law that they seek to raise in the present proceedings.

8. Re-notify on 09th December 2025 before the learned Joint-Registrar for completion of pleadings in CM APPL. No. 61145/2025.
9.

10. Ms. Tiwari submits that they have already deposited a portion of the penalty imposed (decretal amount) before the learned trial court.
If that be so, let the balance amount be deposited in this court within 04 weeks.

Subject to the appellants depositing the decretal amount as above with the Registrar General of this court within 04 weeks from today, the effect and operation of the impugned order dated 21.01.2023 shall remain stayed, till the next date of hearing before this court.

12. The Registrar General is directed to retain the amount deposited in the form of a fixed deposit in a nationalised bank, initially for a period of 01 year; to be renewed for the same period from time-to-time, without awaiting any further directions from this court in that behalf, unless otherwise directed by the court.
13. The Registry is directed to bring to the notice of this court any non- compliance with the directions issued above.
